title: Tio's stroke, decline and death in New York
summary: Tio was paralysed in 1925, could not play as before, went to New York in the Depression and died there.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
